title: Contact Support: Credits, Billing and Results | AIVideosUGC
description: Questions about credits, a failed job, billing or your account? Email support@aivideosugc.com for a written answer and help with your next ad.
lead: Need help with a photo, a video, your credits, or your account? Email support@aivideosugc.com and we will help you sort it out.
intro: Contact AIVideosUGC by email at support@aivideosugc.com and include the details below so one reply can solve it. Email also leaves you a written record of the question and the fix.
Include the email address on your account, a short description of the problem and, if it is about a specific photo or video, roughly when you made it. A screenshot of any error message helps too.

faq.q: How do I reach AIVideosUGC customer service?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. That is the way to reach us, and it gives you a written record of the question and the answer.

faq.q: Can you help before I choose a plan?
faq.a: Yes. If you are not sure the tools suit what you sell, email a short note about the products and where you advertise. We will point you to a starting place, such as [AI image to video](page:image-to-video).

faq.q: How long does a reply take?
faq.a: We do not publish a reply window. Email support@aivideosugc.com with the account email, what happened, and the job time so the first reply can cover it.

faq.q: What details help support find my job?
faq.a: Include the email on your account, a brief description, roughly when it happened, and a screenshot of any error message.

faq.q: What if a failed job did not return credits?
faq.a: Failed jobs return their credits automatically. If you do not see them, email support with the time of the job and we will check it.

faq.q: Do I contact AIVideosUGC by email only?
faq.a: Yes. Email support@aivideosugc.com from the address on your account. This site does not list a phone number.
